papers.title: 4D Biofabrication: 3D Cell Patterning Using Shape‐Changing Films
papers.abstract: Abstract A novel approach for fabrication of 3D cellular structures using new thermosensitive shape‐changing polymer films with photolithographically patterned surface—4D biofabrication is reported. The surface of shape‐changing polymer films is patterned to selectively adsorb cells in specific regions. The 2D cell pattern is converted to the 3D cell structure after temperature‐induced folding of the polymer films. This approach has a great potential in the field of tissue engineering and bioscaffolds fabrication.

summary_zh.motivation: 为组织工程开发无需AI的全新3D细胞结构制造方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用温敏形状记忆薄膜结合光刻图案化实现2D细胞图案到3D结构的折叠。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了具有预定3D几何形状的细胞结构。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞吸附与薄膜折叠实验验证了方法的可行性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to develop a novel fabrication method for 3D cellular structures using shape-changing polymers without AI integration.
summary_en.method: Thermosensitive shape-changing polymer films were photolithographically patterned to selectively adsorb cells, and temperature-induced folding converted the 2D pattern into a 3D cell structure.
summary_en.result: The approach successfully produced 3D cellular constructs with predefined geometries.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through in vitro cell adhesion and film folding experiments demonstrating the feasibility of the technique.
